parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `ReviewRequestServiceTests.recordPlaybackStartedIncrementsCount` (line 22) and `ReviewRequestServiceTests.recordSongAddedToLibraryIncrementsCount` (line 54) — reside in the same test file `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/ReviewRequestServiceTests.swift` and both carry `is_test: true`. Although the two test methods share a similar structural shape (Jaccard 0.75), they exercise distinct user-facing actions (`recordPlaybackStarted` vs. `recordSongAddedToLibrary`) and their parallel structure is intentional: each test independently verifies that a different event increments the review-request counter. Collapsing them into a single generic helper would obscure test intent and make failure messages less diagnostic.
